game_concept: A logic puzzle set in Mystic Forest – Firefly Meadow, a meadow of fireflies: the beast tamer must handle thorn goblins while practicing control flow: for loops. Core idea – Reverse Countdown: Count backward with range(10, 0, -1) to time perfect launches.
theme: Mystic Forest – Firefly Meadow: a meadow of fireflies
core_gameplay_loop: Construct a solution, execute it, inspect actual state and outputs, then revise until all mission goals pass.
player_objective: Source organization: build a valid C source file that prints 26. Put preprocessing before main; keep declarations and statements inside its body. Then test its compiler-factory route: Build the router at (3, 3), with the upper processing path on row 1 and lower path on row 6. IF item value is even, send north to the upper branch; ELSE send south to the lower branch. Merge the two plate streams at (8, 3), then use the shared assembler and output. Deliver exactly 13 components (6 upper, 7 lower). Set the gold-socket controller batch to 13.
controls: Drag sprites onto the grid. R rotates new pieces. Set fork output directions and router conditions in the inspector. Splitters alternate; routers evaluate each item; mergers accept one waiting item at a time fairly. Set batch size, connect power, repair rounded conveyors, then Run or Step. Grid controls are the keyboard alternative.
win_condition: The executed solution satisfies every output and world-state check.
lose_condition: The available unsuccessful execution checks are exhausted.
assets_style: Shared Kenney CC0 tile and audio assets with deterministic Canvas layouts; assets are not duplicated per game.
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Reverse Countdown' (Week 5 slot 8), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Firefly Meadow'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.
topic: C Components, Keywords, Preprocessor and Organization

region.name: Mystic Forest
region.mood: airy flutes, birdsong and soft magical chimes

tutorial: Read the objective, fixtures and command reference.
Build the circuit or route, or edit the node/adventure program.
Use Step to inspect state; Run checks the real outputs and goals.
Revise errors before using the remaining execution checks.
source_player_objective: Reach the elder's door using at most 22 actions, so every code step counts.
source_win_condition: The elder's door reached with actions_used <= 22.
source_lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 22 before the elder's door is reached, or lives reach 0.
hint: IF item value is even, send north to the upper branch; ELSE send south to the lower branch. Merge the two plate streams at (8, 3), then use the shared assembler and output.
